sentences.text: The documents do not state a specific pre-payment penalty for gold loans.
The only pre-payment charge amounts in the documents are 2% of the principal outstanding in a Home Loan Agreement and 3% of the principal outstanding in a copy of that agreement.

For cases other than those mentioned at paragraph 261(1) and (2), pre-payment charges, if any, shall be as per the approved policy of a UCB, and the policy text shown here defines “pre-payment” or “pre-closure” as repayment of a loan, in full or in part, before its scheduled due date.
